# Test data

`vectors-v1.json` is a byte-for-byte copy of `test-vectors/v1.json` from
[m-sign/specs](https://github.com/m-sign/specs). It is generated there by
`tools/vectors.py`, an independent reference implementation.

- Source: m-sign/specs, `test-vectors/v1.json`, spec version 1.0.0
- SHA-256: `0bddad7175fc34c721055bde4e9f5f6e259b59faaa8d62a55e74a538b745d262`

Do not edit this file by hand. To update it, copy the new version from the
specs repository and update the hash above. Once the specs repository is
tagged, set the repository variable `SPECS_VECTORS_REF` to that tag (for
example `v1.0.0`) so that CI checks the copy against the published file.

All keys in the vectors are published test keys. Never use them for real
signing.
